label: In the same context/world, a common through-source for all…, by Typed-premise-strength-audit
meaning: Under the four explicit GLOBAL background premises, common-through for all self-through bearers is equivalent to one unique actual ultimate source. Forward: instantiate the existing uniqueness proof with a proof-only power interpretation equal to through; the original ontology and through relation are unchanged, so the source conclusion is definitionally the same. No original selfPowerFrom facts follow. Reverse: ultimate availability gives each self-through bearer an actual ultimate source; uniqueness identifies it with the one same source. This is a strength audit, not independent justification or a proof of circularity. No equivalent-strength claim is made for the original power bundle or for the local ancestry theorem lacking global ultimate availability.
